description: REFERENCE (rom_signature + segments) for Golden Sun GBA (AGSE, GS1 ONLY). Contextual Huffman compression recovered via goldensun-decomp. JSON cannot express Huffman, so this config DOCUMENTS the real fixed-range areas from gba_golden_sun.py (GS1): contextual Huffman section 0x37464-0x38334 (256 trees + offset table) and the string-file pointer table 0x736B8-0x73808 (42 files x 8 bytes). Full extraction (decompressed dialog strings) requires the Python plugin GoldenSunPlugin (gba_golden_sun.py) - the JSON config is NOT usable for extraction as-is. Golden Sun: The Lost Age (AGFE) uses different addresses - use gba_golden_sun_tla.py for it. Hack authors: copy and adapt title_pattern to match YOUR hack ROM title.
